uygur: Uygur is a member of a people who speak Uighur and live in Xinjiang and adjacent areas.
Uygur can also mean the Turkic language spoken by approximately 7,000,000 Uighur in extreme northwestern China.
Uygur can also mean the script used to write the Uighur language.
Uygur means the same as Uighur or Uigur.
